lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਲਖ ਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣੰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur gur sev alakh gat jaa kee sree raamadaas taaran tarana(n) ||2||
lines.translation: So serve the Guru, the True Guru; His ways and means are inscrutable. The Great Guru Raam Daas is the Boat to carry us across. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਯਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saar agam saagar tulahaa har naam guroo mukh paayaa ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord, from the Mouth of the Guru, is the Raft to cross over the unfathomable world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਗਾ ਇਹ ਆਈ ਹੀਐ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jag janam maran bhagaa ih aaee heeai parateet ||
lines.translation: The cycle of birth and death in this world is ended for those who have this faith in their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੀਐ ਆਈ ਜਿਨ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਪਦਵੀ ਉਚ ਭਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: parateet heeai aaee jin jan kai tinh kau padavee uch bhaee ||
lines.translation: Those humble beings who have this faith in their hearts, are awarded the highest status.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਰੁ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੀ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਗਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj maaiaa mohu lobh ar laalach kaam krodh kee brithaa gaee ||
lines.translation: They forsake Maya, emotional attachment and greed; they are rid of the frustrations of possessiveness, sexual desire and anger.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਲੋਕੵਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਛੁਟਕੵਾ ਦਿਬੵ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਟਿ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: avalokyaa braham bharam sabh chhutakyaa diby drist kaaran karana(n) ||
lines.translation: They are blessed with the Inner Vision to see God, the Cause of causes, and all their doubts are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਲਖ ਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣੰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: satigur gur sev alakh gat jaa kee sree raamadaas taaran tarana(n) ||3||
lines.translation: So serve the Guru, the True Guru; His ways and means are inscrutable. The Great Guru Raam Daas is the Boat to carry us across. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਯਾ ਜਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: parataap sadaa gur kaa ghat ghat paragaas bhayaa jas jan kai ||
lines.translation: The Glorious Greatness of the Guru is manifest forever in each and every heart. His humble servants sing His Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪਰਭਾਤਿਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਸ੍ਨਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik paRahi sunahi gaavahi parabhaatihi karahi isnaan ||
lines.translation: Some read and listen and sing of Him, taking their cleansing bath in the early hours of the morning before the dawn.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸ੍ਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਭਾਤਿ ਸੁਧ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਜਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਹਿਤ ਕਰੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: isnaan karahi parabhaat sudh man gur poojaa bidh sahit kara(n) ||
lines.translation: After their cleansing bath in the hours before the dawn, they worship the Guru with their minds pure and clear.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਕਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਧੵਾਨੁ ਧਰੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)chan tan hoi paras paaras kau jot saroopee dhyaan dhara(n) ||
lines.translation: Touching the Philosopher's Stone, their bodies are transformed into gold. They focus their meditation on the Embodiment of Divine Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪੂਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਰਨੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jagajeevan jaga(n)naath jal thal mahi rahiaa poor bahu bidh barana(n) ||
lines.translation: The Master of the Universe, the very Life of the World pervades the sea and the land, manifesting Himself in myriads of ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਲਖ ਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣੰ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: satigur gur sev alakh gat jaa kee sree raamadaas taaran tarana(n) ||4||
lines.translation: So serve the Guru, the True Guru; His ways and means are inscrutable. The Great Guru Raam Daas is the Boat to carry us across. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਹੁ ਬਾਤ ਨਿਸ੍ਚਲ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੇਈ ਜੀਵ ਕਾਲ ਤੇ ਬਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinahu baat nischal dhroo jaanee teee jeev kaal te bachaa ||
lines.translation: Those who realize the Eternal, Unchanging Word of God, like Dhroo, are immune to death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਤਰਿਓ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰੁ ਖਿਨ ਇਕ ਮਹਿ ਜਲਹਰ ਬਿੰਬ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਗੁ ਰਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tinh tario samudr rudr khin ik mahi jalahar bi(n)b jugat jag rachaa ||
lines.translation: They cross over the terrifying world-ocean in an instant; the Lord created the world like a bubble of water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਡਲਨੀ ਸੁਰਝੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ku(n)dalanee surajhee satasa(n)gat paramaana(n)d guroo mukh machaa ||
lines.translation: The Kundalini rises in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; through the Word of the Guru, they enjoy the Lord of Supreme Bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰੰਮ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: siree guroo saahib sabh oopar man bach kra(n)m seveeai sachaa ||5||
lines.translation: The Supreme Guru is the Lord and Master over all; so serve the True Guru, in thought, word and deed. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahi jeeu ||
lines.translation: Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਲ ਨੈਨ ਮਧੁਰ ਬੈਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੈਨ ਸੰਗ ਸੋਭ ਕਹਤ ਮਾ ਜਸੋਦ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦਹੀ ਭਾਤੁ ਖਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaval nain madhur bain kot sain sa(n)g sobh kahat maa jasod jisahi dahee bhaat khaahi jeeu ||
lines.translation: You are lotus-eyed, with sweet speech, exalted and embellished with millions of companions. Mother Yashoda invited You as Krishna to eat the sweet rice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾ ਮਗ ਭਈ ਕਿੰਕਨੀ ਸਬਦ ਝਨਤਕਾਰ ਖੇਲੁ ਪਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dekh roop at anoop moh mahaa mag bhaee ki(n)kanee sabad jhanatakaar khel paahi jeeu ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon Your supremely beautiful form, and hearing the musical sounds of Your silver bells tinkling, she was intoxicated with delight.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਕਲਮ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਕੈ ਈਸੁ ਬੰਮੵੁ ਗੵਾਨੁ ਧੵਾਨੁ ਧਰਤ ਹੀਐ ਚਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaal kalam hukam haath kahahu kaun met sakai ees ba(n)my gyaan dhyaan dharat heeai chaahi jeeu ||
lines.translation: Death's pen and command are in Your hands. Tell me, who can erase it? Shiva and Brahma yearn to enshrine Your spiritual wisdom in their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: sat saach sree nivaas aad purakh sadaa tuhee vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahi jeeu ||1||6||
lines.translation: You are forever True, the Home of Excellence, the Primal Supreme Being. Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o. ||1||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਮ ਧਾਮ ਸੁਧ ਬੁਧ ਨਿਰੀਕਾਰ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਸਰਬਰ ਕਉ ਕਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam param dhaam sudh budh nireekaar besumaar sarabar kau kaahi jeeu ||
lines.translation: You are blessed with the Lord's Name, the supreme mansion, and clear understanding. You are the Formless, Infinite Lord; who can compare to You?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਥਰ ਚਿਤ ਭਗਤ ਹਿਤ ਭੇਖੁ ਧਰਿਓ ਹਰਨਾਖਸੁ ਹਰਿਓ ਨਖ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: suthar chit bhagat hit bhekh dhario haranaakhas hario nakh bidaar jeeu ||
lines.translation: For the sake of the pure-hearted devotee Prahlaad, You took the form of the man-lion, to tear apart and destroy Harnaakhash with your claws.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਖ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਗਦਾ ਪਦਮ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੁ ਕੀਓ ਛਦਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਖੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਤਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)kh chakr gadaa padam aap aap keeo chhadam apara(n)par paarabraham lakhai kaun taahi jeeu ||
lines.translation: You are the Infinite Supreme Lord God; with your symbols of power, You deceived Baliraja; who can know You?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sat saach sree nivaas aad purakh sadaa tuhee vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahi jeeu ||2||7||
lines.translation: You are forever True, the Home of Excellence, the Primal Supreme Being. Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o. ||2||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੀਤ ਬਸਨ ਕੁੰਦ ਦਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਸਹਿਤ ਕੰਠ ਮਾਲ ਮੁਕਟੁ ਸੀਸਿ ਮੋਰ ਪੰਖ ਚਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: peet basan ku(n)d dasan priaa sahit ka(n)th maal mukat sees mor pa(n)kh chaahi jeeu ||
lines.translation: As Krishna, You wear yellow robes, with teeth like jasmine flowers; You dwell with Your lovers, with Your mala around Your neck, and You joyfully adorn Your head with the crow of peacock feathers.
